## Safety and conduct checklist

- [ ] Kebera stays **read-only**: no logins, password handling, settings changes, exploits or traffic capture added
- [ ] No new way to point Kebera at targets other than the user's own equipment and the approved test services
- [ ] No identifiers in code, docs, screenshots or test data (SIM/phone numbers, IMEI/IMSI, serial numbers, MAC addresses, passwords, full public IPs)
- [ ] User-facing text is plain language and neutral (measurements, not blame)
- [ ] PowerShell files stay ASCII-only and work on Windows PowerShell 5.1
- [ ] AI-generated parts (if any) were reviewed and tested by me
- [ ] I have read and agree to the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) and the [Acceptable Use Policy](../ACCEPTABLE_USE.md)
